newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank seeks bankruptcy for eight banks.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank seeks bankruptcy for eight banks.

text.p: Bulgaria's central bank said on Thursday that it initiated bankruptcy proceedings through the courts for eight of the nine banks placed in receivership in September.
"The BNB Board decided to seek bankruptcy for eight banks on the basis of their insolvency," the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said in a statement.
The BNB named the banks as Balkanbank, Businessbank, Dobrodhza Bank, Mollov Bank, Slavyani Bank, Economic Bank, Trade and Savings Bank and Yambol Bank.

Balkanbank, Economic Bank and Yambol Bank are state-owned, the rest are private. The eight banks, plus private Elitbank, were placed in receivership on September 23 due to their negative capital to assets ratio.

The BNB said it would continue to discuss the financial status of Elitbank and also Bank for Agricultural Credit, in which the BNB has a stake. The BNB said in September it would discuss its restructuring.
